$description: Acxiom design tokens, derived from AcxiomMasterTemplate_2026.pdf (v1.0, January 2026) and AcxiomValueDeck_2026.pdf. Values were extracted from the source PDFs, not estimated.

core.$description: The four colors that carry the brand. Every layout is built on black or bone.

black.$description: Primary dark surface. The default canvas for covers, section dividers, and hero moments.

bone.$description: Primary light surface. Warm off-white — never substitute pure white for it as a background.

white.$description: Body text on dark surfaces, and fills inside charts and diagrams.

plum.$description: Deep aubergine. Secondary dark surface, card fills, and the third chart series.

accent.$description: Use sparingly and never for body text. Reserved for data, diagrams, and highlights.

magenta.$description: Signature accent. First choice for emphasis and the lead chart series.

blue.$description: Second accent. Leads the column chart series order.

orange.$description: Third accent. Lowest-frequency — diagram keys and gradient stops.

grey.$description: Chart neutral, table rules, and inactive states on light surfaces.

grey-dark.$description: Secondary label text on light surfaces.

bone-shade.$description: Dividers and hairlines on bone surfaces.

gradient-stop.$description: Endpoints used by the glow and the gradient strokes. Not standalone fill colors.

text.$description: Text is black or white only. Accent colors are never used for type.

on-dark-display.$description: Display headlines on black read as bone, not pure white.

glow.$description: The signature cover glow — an angled beam of light across a black canvas. In the PowerPoint template it ships as a pasteable PNG overlay; reproduce it with this ramp in web and print work.

display.$description: Tw Cen MT carries all headlines and body copy. Licensed via Monotype; the fallbacks are the closest geometric sans faces.

mono.$description: Consolas is the eyebrow/label voice. It is ALWAYS set in uppercase with wide tracking — never sentence case, never as body copy.

regular.$description: The template is almost entirely regular weight. Bold appears rarely and only in the value deck.

typography.$description: Sizes are in points on the native 960x540pt slide canvas, which maps 1:1 to px in a 960x540 web frame. Do not increase headline or subheading sizes; body text is the only size you may adjust.

title.$description: Oversized standalone statements inside a section.

heading.$description: Standard slide headline. Sits at x=28.8pt, top=19.2pt on every content slide.

caption.$description: Icon captions and chart axis labels.

eyebrow.$description: The kicker above a headline. Consolas, uppercase, widely tracked — the most recognizable type gesture in the system.

label.$description: Bullet keys and micro-labels. Tracking widens as the size drops.

footer.$description: Copyright line and page number in the slide footer.

layout.$description: The native canvas is a 16:9 slide at 960x540pt.

margin.$description: 0.4in. Left, right, and the outer edge of the footer. Headlines and body copy align to it.

headline-offset-top.$description: Cap height of the slide headline from the top edge.

none.$description: Boxes in the flow-chart system are square-cornered. Radius is the exception, not the default.

source.$description: Native raster size of every shipped icon PNG.

slide.$description: Typical placed size on a slide.
